items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet suffered a non-contact knee injury late in Thursday's win over Patriots, carted off, ruled out; coach Ben Johnson said 'I don’t think it looked very good,' more tests Friday.
items.implication: Significant absence likely; opens TE snaps/routes for Loveland and depth
items.opportunity: Loveland route/target share expansion in CHI 12 personnel and red zone

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday with a calf injury and was listed as limited; already thin at WR with Adams on IR.
items.why: Exited practice early, calf; listed limited
items.implication: Game-time or miss risk vs LV; monitor Friday report
items.opportunity: If out/inactive, elevated targets for remaining WRs/TEs (Higbee etc.) post-Adams

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: High miss risk Week 7; monitor designation
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy / other KC WRs target bump if OUT

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall back to practice Thursday after prior absence; not ruled out for Week 7.
items.implication: Upgrade chance to play; monitor snaps vs prior week-to-week
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Braelon Allen elevated carries

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed facility access for meetings/lifting/medical (non-football); MarShawn Lloyd 49th and Kaleb Johnson 53rd in EPA/rush among qualifiers, OL mess too. Long-term Jacobs outlook discussed on ROS Top-150.
items.why: Facility access positive; backups poor EPA/efficiency
items.implication: Jacobs closer to return and preferred long-term; fade inefficient committee mates
items.opportunity: Jacobs handcuff value / role lock on return; low EPA limits Lloyd upside

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson got in limited work Wednesday (and Thursday updates similar); optimism growing but not lock for return.
items.why: Ankle; limited participation after earlier absence
items.implication: Questionable leaning play possible; confirm Friday
items.opportunity: If active, full QB1; if out, backup streaming implications

items.text: Notable: Terrance Ferguson (eligible off IR next week) not expected ready, recovery 'will take some time.' Rams' only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game post-Adams.
items.why: Ferguson delay + Adams IR leaves Puka as primary
items.implication: Massive target monopoly for healthy Puka; calf news creates risk
items.opportunity: 25-tgt ceiling if active; TE/Higbee spillover if Puka limited
items.conflict: Conflicts with fresh calf limited status

items.text: 10 Facts: Stroud 6th-best QB last 3 wks, top yards/attempts; Nix aDOT 5.4 (only 4 completions >=7 air yds last 2); Jeanty inefficient (<3 YPC 4/5), Washington snaps up to 33%.
items.implication: Stroud QB1 upside; fade Nix/Broncos WRs; monitor Jeanty role split
items.opportunity: Washington committee threat if Jeanty continues poor

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10): Bears good for yardage, high target share/routes (97% routes, 33% share prior) despite drops; buying the usage/matchup.
items.why: Usage elite + soft Bears secondary for yardage
items.opportunity: High routes/targets vs vulnerable pass D

items.text: Loves DeVonta Smith vs DAL, Tucker Kraft @ DET, Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR: usage + friendly matchups (Lions pass D gift, RB-friendly spots).
items.why: Workloads + matchups (Lions deep/pass D soft, RB volume spots)
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/carries in positive game scripts/matchups

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE, Josh Downs @ MIN, Josh Jacobs @ DET, Cam Skattebo @ HOU: tough spots, workload questions post-layoff for Jacobs, brutal matchups.
items.implication: Sit or fade relative to ADP/projections
items.conflict: Levitan more constructive on Jacobs facility/access

items.text: Thorman Week 7 Snaps & Pace: Up in pace TB @ CAR; slow slogs MIA @ NYJ; other notes GB/DET/LAR/LV high volume. Rankings live (paywall).
items.implication: Prefer volume in high-pace games (TB/CAR); avoid slogs
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/route opportunities in up-tempo spots

items.text: Bears ruled out RB Kyle Monangai for TNF vs Patriots; misses third straight (thumb/turf toe).
items.implication: Swift/lead back clearer path in CHI backfield for TNF

items.text: Giants start J.J. McCarthy vs HOU. Yards per target to Justin Jefferson: Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9, McCarthy 5.7. Different scheme/coaches/small sample but hard to ignore.
items.why: McCarthy YPT to JJ historically low vs other QBs
items.implication: Jefferson efficiency/ceiling concern with McCarthy start
items.opportunity: Monitor early chemistry; possible volume still but lower YAC/YPT
